description: Unit test class for the ImmutableAccessControlList in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It verifies immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, permission merging, and ACL management functionalities related to access control lists.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlListTest
classes.description: Test suite for ImmutableAccessControlList ensuring correctness, immutability, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ACL object before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableAccessControlList is effectively immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equality and hashCode implementations for the class.

methods.name: emptyAclIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an empty ACL reports as empty.

methods.name: emptyAclHasSizeZero
methods.description: Verifies that the size of an empty ACL is zero.

methods.name: mergeAclEntryWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests merging a single ACL entry into the list.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsForWritePermission
methods.description: Retrieves authorization subjects with WRITE permission.

methods.name: mergeAuthorizationSubjectWithMultiplePermissions
methods.description: Merges an authorization subject with multiple permissions.

methods.name: mergeEntryCreatesDisjointAcl
methods.description: Tests that merging entries creates a disjoint ACL.

methods.name: tryToSetNullAclEntry
methods.description: Ensures setting a null ACL entry throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setEntryCreatesDisjointAcl
methods.description: Verifies setting an entry replaces previous disjoint entries.

methods.name: tryToGetAclEntryForNullAuthoriztionSubject
methods.description: Ensures retrieving ACL entry for null subject throws exception.

methods.name: getAclEntryForAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Retrieves ACL entry for a given authorization subject.

methods.name: tryToGetPermissionsForNullAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Ensures retrieving permissions for null subject throws exception.

methods.name: getPermissionsForBarSubject
methods.description: Gets permissions assigned to a specific subject.

methods.name: checkPermissionsForAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Checks if a subject has specific permissions.

methods.name: mergeAclPermissionWithMultipleAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Merges permissions across multiple subjects.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsForAdministratePermission
methods.description: Gets subjects authorized for ADMINISTRATE permission.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getSize returns correct count.

methods.name: removeLastPermissionOfAuthorizationSubjectRemovesWholeAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Removes last permission and thus removes the subject.

methods.name: removeSoleEntryOfAcl
methods.description: Removes the only entry from the ACL.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOfBazSubject
methods.description: Removes all permissions for a given subject.

methods.name: getEntriesReturnsDisjointSet
methods.description: Retrieves all ACL entries as a set and verifies disjointness.

methods.name: tryToCreateAclFromNullJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures creating ACL from null JSON throws exception.

methods.name: createAccessControlListFromValidJson
methods.description: Creates ACL from valid JSON string and verifies correctness.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpectedJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that toJson produces expected JSON output.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Ensures setting null permissions for all subjects throws exception.

methods.name: setEmptyPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjectsCreatesEmptyAcl
methods.description: Verifies that setting empty permissions clears the ACL.

methods.name: setPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets new permissions for all subjects.

methods.name: removeAclEntryFromAclWithoutThisEntry
methods.description: Removing non-existing entry returns the same ACL.

methods.name: setPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjectsOnEmptyAcl
methods.description: Setting permissions on an empty ACL results in same empty ACL.

methods.name: ensureAclToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Verifies that toBuilder followed by build produces equivalent ACL.
